sn44.9:1.1: Then the wanderer Vacchagotta approached the Blessed One and exchanged greetings with him.
sn44.9:1.2: When they had concluded their greetings and cordial talk, he sat down to one side and said to the Blessed One:
sn44.9:2.1: “In recent days, Master Gotama, a number of ascetics, brahmins, and wanderers of various sects had assembled in the debating hall and were sitting together when this conversation arose among them:
sn44.9:2.2: ‘This Pūraṇa Kassapa—the leader of an order, the leader of a group, the teacher of a group, the well known and famous spiritual guide considered holy by many people—
sn44.9:2.3: declares the rebirth of a disciple who has passed away and died thus:
sn44.9:2.4: “That one was reborn there, that one was reborn there.”
sn44.9:2.5: And in the case of a disciple who was a person of the highest kind, a supreme person, one who had attained the supreme attainment, when that disciple has passed away and died he also declares his rebirth thus:
sn44.9:2.6: “That one was reborn there, that one was reborn there.”
sn44.9:3.8: when that disciple has passed away and died he also declares his rebirth thus:
sn44.9:3.9: “That one was reborn there, that one was reborn there.”
sn44.9:4.1: This ascetic Gotama—the leader of an order, the leader of a group, the teacher of a group, the well known and famous spiritual guide considered holy by many people—
sn44.9:4.2: declares the rebirth of a disciple who has passed away and died thus:
sn44.9:4.3: “That one was reborn there, that one was reborn there.”
sn44.9:4.4: But in the case of a disciple who was a person of the highest kind, a supreme person, one who had attained the supreme attainment, when that disciple has passed away and died he does not declare his rebirth thus:
sn44.9:4.5: “That one was reborn there, that one was reborn there.”
sn44.9:4.7: “He cut off craving, severed the fetter, and, by completely breaking through conceit, he has made an end to suffering.”’
sn44.9:4.8: “There was perplexity in me, Master Gotama, there was doubt:
sn44.9:4.9: ‘How is the Dhamma of the ascetic Gotama to be understood?’”
sn44.9:5.1: “It is fitting for you to be perplexed, Vaccha, it is fitting for you to doubt.
sn44.9:5.2: Doubt has arisen in you about a perplexing matter.
sn44.9:5.3: I declare, Vaccha, rebirth for one with fuel, not for one without fuel.
sn44.9:5.4: Just as a fire burns with fuel, but not without fuel,
sn44.9:5.5: so, Vaccha, I declare rebirth for one with fuel, not for one without fuel.”
sn44.9:6.1: “Master Gotama, when a flame is flung by the wind and goes some distance, what does Master Gotama declare to be its fuel on that occasion?”
sn44.9:6.2: “When, Vaccha, a flame is flung by the wind and goes some distance, I declare that it is fuelled by the wind.
sn44.9:6.3: For on that occasion the wind is its fuel.”
sn44.9:6.4: “And, Master Gotama, when a being has laid down this body but has not yet been reborn in another body, what does Master Gotama declare to be its fuel on that occasion?”
sn44.9:6.5: “When, Vaccha, a being has laid down this body but has not yet been reborn in another body, I declare that it is fuelled by craving.
sn44.9:6.6: For on that occasion craving is its fuel.”
